---
title: "Emaan Nahi Hai Jis Ka Bhi Youm E Ghadeer Par"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Hasnain"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Emaan Nahi Hai Jis Ka Bhi Youm e Ghadeer Par.
Lanat Khuda Bhi Karta Hai Oss Be Zameer Par.
Ayelan Ho Raha Hai Wilaye Ali Ka Aaj.
Mil Kar Darood Bhejiye Shiyon Ke Peer Par.

2
Ghairon Ko De Ke Bartari Bidat Na Kijiye.
Takmeel-e-Deen Ho Chuki Maula Ameer Par.
Mumkin Hai Aaj Bhi Wohi Munkir Pe Aa Parin.
Jo Sang Khum Mein Barsay They Haris Shareer Par.

3
Bidat Bata Rahe Hain Jo Nazar-o-Niyaz Ko.
Nazrein Jami Hain Unn Ki Bhi Halway Pe Kheer Par.
Jo Bhi Aseer Ulfat-e-Haider Ka Ho Gaya.
Qismat Bhi Naaz Karti Hai Aisay Aseer Par.

4
Maidan-e-Khum Dikhai Diya Dil Ki Aankh Se.
Do Bhaiyon Ko Dekha Hai Nazron Ke Teer Par.
 Hasnain Ne Jali Ke Ali Ka Likha Kalam.
Haider Ki Yeh Atta Hoi Adna Faqeer Par.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/emaan-nahi-hai-jis-ka-bhi-youm-e-ghadeer-par-tajpoints-9b13ae54b77136cd6683.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in ((roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')):
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        heading, *verses = block.splitlines()
        assert heading.strip() == number and len(verses) == 4
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Verified four stanzas of four verses in both editions.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have four stanzas of four verses. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

The phrase “Jali ke Ali” is ambiguous. I rendered it phonetically as “جلی کے علی”.
